about: Display text for lines whose pronouns for God, Jesus or the Holy Spirit are capitalised. Each value is the pool line with only the first letter of those pronouns raised; the pool keeps the verbatim text. Reviewed line by line; test-game.mjs proves no other character differs.

lines.webbe:ISA.38.3: Remember now, LORD, I beg You, how I have walked before You in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in Your sight.
lines.webbe:JDG.10.15: We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems good to You; only deliver us, please, today.
lines.webbe:JDG.11.23: So now the LORD, the God of Israel, has dispossessed the Amorites from before His people Israel, and should you possess them?
lines.webbe:JDG.15.18: You have given this great deliverance by the hand of Your servant; and now shall I die of thirst, and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?
lines.webbe:JER.42.21: I have declared it to you today; but you have not obeyed the LORD your God’s voice in anything for which He has sent me to you.
lines.webbe:JHN.10.33: We don’t stone You for a good work, but for blasphemy, because You, being a man, make Yourself God.
lines.webbe:JHN.11.22: Even now I know that whatever You ask of God, God will give You.
lines.webbe:JHN.11.27: Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that You are the Christ, God’s Son, He Who comes into the world.
lines.webbe:JHN.11.56: What do you think—that He isn’t coming to the feast at all?
lines.webbe:JHN.12.34: We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do You say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?
lines.webbe:JHN.16.15: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that He takes of mine and will declare it to you.
lines.webbe:JHN.17.4: I glorified You on the earth. I have accomplished the work which You have given me to do.
lines.webbe:JHN.18.30: If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered Him up to you.
lines.webbe:JHN.18.35: I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered You to me. What have You done?
lines.webbe:JHN.2.20: It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will You raise it up in three days?
lines.webbe:JHN.6.69: We have come to believe and know that You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
lines.webbe:JHN.8.13: You testify about Yourself. Your testimony is not valid.
lines.webbe:JHN.8.48: Don’t we say well that You are a Samaritan, and have a demon?
lines.webbe:JHN.8.53: Are You greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do You make Yourself out to be?
lines.webbe:JHN.8.55: You have not known Him, but I know Him. If I said, ‘I don’t know Him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know Him and keep His word.
lines.webbe:JHN.9.25: I don’t know if He is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.
lines.webbe:JHN.9.27: I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become His disciples, do you?
lines.webbe:JHN.9.29: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where He comes from.
lines.webbe:JHN.9.31: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshipper of God and does His will, He listens to him.
lines.webbe:JOB.10.9: Remember, I beg You, that You have fashioned me as clay. Will You bring me into dust again?
lines.webbe:JOB.11.10: If He passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose Him?
lines.webbe:JOB.11.11: For He knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though He doesn’t consider it.
lines.webbe:JOB.12.16: With Him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are His.
lines.webbe:JOB.12.23: He increases the nations, and He destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and He leads them captive.
lines.webbe:JOB.22.13: You say, ‘What does God know? Can He judge through the thick darkness?
lines.webbe:JOB.22.27: You will make your prayer to Him, and He will hear you. You will pay your vows.
lines.webbe:JOB.22.3: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit Him that you make your ways perfect?
lines.webbe:JOB.22.4: Is it for your piety that He reproves you, that He enters with you into judgement?
lines.webbe:JOB.23.5: I would know the words which He would answer me, and understand what He would tell me.
lines.webbe:JOB.25.2: Dominion and fear are with Him. He makes peace in His high places.
lines.webbe:JOB.30.20: I cry to You, and You do not answer me. I stand up, and You gaze at me.
lines.webbe:JOB.30.23: For I know that You will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.
lines.webbe:JOB.33.13: Why do you strive against Him, because He doesn’t give account of any of His matters?
lines.webbe:JOB.34.13: Who put Him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed Him over the whole world?
lines.webbe:JOB.34.25: Therefore He takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
lines.webbe:JOB.36.11: If they listen and serve Him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
lines.webbe:JOB.36.29: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of His pavilion?
lines.webbe:JOB.37.15: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of His cloud to shine?
lines.webbe:JOB.37.6: For He says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of His mighty rain.
lines.webbe:JOB.4.18: Behold, He puts no trust in His servants. He charges His angels with error.
lines.webbe:JOB.8.4: If your children have sinned against Him, He has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.
lines.webbe:JON.1.9: I am a Hebrew, and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, Who has made the sea and the dry land.
lines.webbe:JON.2.9: But I will sacrifice to You with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to the LORD.
lines.webbe:JOS.23.10: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is the LORD your God Who fights for you, as He spoke to you.
lines.webbe:JOS.24.24: We will serve the LORD our God, and we will listen to His voice.
lines.webbe:JOS.7.19: My son, please give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and make confession to Him. Tell me now what you have done! Don’t hide it from me!
lines.webbe:JOS.7.9: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and will surround us, and cut off our name from the earth. What will You do for Your great name?
lines.webbe:LUK.1.49: For He Who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is His name.
lines.webbe:LUK.2.48: Son, why have You treated us this way? Behold, Your father and I were anxiously looking for You.
lines.webbe:LUK.4.3: If You are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.
lines.webbe:LUK.4.7: If You therefore will worship before me, it will all be Yours.
lines.webbe:LUK.9.40: I begged Your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.
lines.webbe:MAT.17.16: So I brought him to Your disciples, and they could not cure him.
lines.webbe:MAT.2.13: Arise and take the young child and His mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy Him.
lines.webbe:MAT.23.39: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is He Who comes in the name of the Lord!’
lines.webbe:MAT.27.13: Don’t You hear how many things they testify against You?
lines.webbe:MAT.4.9: I will give You all of these things, if You will fall down and worship me.
lines.webbe:MAT.6.10: Let Your Kingdom come. Let Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
lines.webbe:MAT.6.33: But seek first God’s Kingdom and His righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
lines.webbe:MRK.1.8: I baptised you in water, but He will baptise you in the Holy Spirit.
lines.webbe:MRK.10.28: Behold, we have left all and have followed You.
lines.webbe:MRK.14.31: If I must die with You, I will not deny You.
lines.webbe:MRK.14.36: Abba, Father, all things are possible to You. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what You desire.
lines.webbe:MRK.14.71: I don’t know this man of Whom you speak!
lines.webbe:MRK.15.12: What then should I do to Him Whom you call the King of the Jews?
lines.webbe:MRK.5.31: You see the multitude pressing against You, and You say, ‘Who touched me?’
lines.webbe:MRK.9.22: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if You can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.
lines.webbe:MRK.9.5: Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
lines.webbe:NUM.21.7: We have sinned, because we have spoken against the LORD and against you. Pray to the LORD, that He take away the serpents from us.
lines.webbe:NUM.23.3: Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. Whatever He shows me I will tell you.
lines.webbe:NUM.32.13: The LORD’s anger burnt against Israel, and He made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.
lines.webbe:REV.17.14: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with Him are called, chosen, and faithful.
lines.webbe:RUT.2.12: May the LORD repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from the LORD, the God of Israel, under Whose wings you have come to take refuge.
